name: (Visitant) Roar

source.title: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God

text:
The visitant lets out a loud and horrifying roar. Each creature within 100 feet must attempt at a Will save save.

No matter the result, affected creatures are then temporarily immune to the effect for 1 minute.

---

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 3.
